title: Normalized arithmetic interpolation and its actual finite-reduction comparisons
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $R$ and uniformizer $\varpi$, and a scheme $T$ on which $\ell$ is invertible [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension, def-pc-scheme]. On a small skeleton of $T_{\mathrm{proét}}$ put $B_k=(R/\varpi^k)_T$ and $A=\varprojlim_kB_k$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Fix $e\geq1$. Write $\mathscr S(B)$ and $\mathscr S(B_r)$ for strict semilinear module systems over $(B_k)_k$ and $(B_{en})_n$, with their ordinary unbounded derived categories [lem-pur-system-level-left-extension]. Let $C\in D(\mathscr S(B_r))$ satisfy normalization: all actual transition adjoints $B_{ea}\otimes^L_{B_{eb}}C_b\to C_a$ for $b\geq a\geq1$ are isomorphisms. No boundedness, constructibility or Tor bounds are assumed.

Let $F=L_rC$ be the derived left extension adjoint to arithmetic restriction $U$, specified in [lem-pur-system-level-left-extension]. Its natural evaluation formulas are
$$F_k=B_k\otimes^L_{B_{e\lceil k/e\rceil}}C_{\lceil k/e\rceil},\qquad UF\cong C.$$
The second isomorphism identifies the selected transitions with those of $C$. For $a=\lceil k/e\rceil$ and $b=\lceil(k+1)/e\rceil$, its adjacent transition adjoint is the map
$$B_k\otimes^L_{B_{eb}}C_b\longrightarrow B_k\otimes^L_{B_{ea}}C_a$$
induced by the actual selected transition adjoint (the identity when $a=b$), under canonical tensor associators. Every transition adjoint of $F$ is an isomorphism, including composites between nonadjacent levels. After scalar forgetting $F$ determines a coherent normalized DVR tower [def-coef-normalized-dvr-tower]. Put $M=R\varprojlim_n\operatorname{Res}C_n$ and $\mathcal L_BF=R\varprojlim_k\operatorname{Res}F_k$, using total derived inverse limit [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-strict-tower-homotopy-limit]. The canonical arithmetic restriction comparison gives $\mathcal L_BF\cong M$, identifying the projections at $en$ with those to $C_n$. The canonical scalar-extension adjoints of those projections are isomorphisms
$$M\otimes_A^L B_{en}\xrightarrow{\sim}C_n.$$
These are the selected actual counit comparisons of the uniformizer reduction/total-limit adjunction [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus], and hence are coherent in $D(\mathscr S(B_r))$, not merely unrelated evaluated isomorphisms.

proof.text: Apply [lem-pur-system-level-left-extension] to $r(n)=en$. Since $e\geq1$, this is strictly increasing and unbounded, and its least selected index above $k$ is $t(k)=\lceil k/e\rceil$. The stated evaluation and adjacent-transition formulas give exactly those in the assertion. Let $\eta_C:C\to UL_rC=UF$ be the actual unit of the adjunction $L_r\dashv U$ of that node, a morphism in $D(\mathscr S(B_r))$. Since $L_r$ is the total left derived functor of the strict-system left extension along the subsequence inclusion with the displayed evaluations, $\eta_C$ is computed on a resolution of $C$ by the underived unit, whose level $n$ is the canonical identification $C_n\cong B_{en}\otimes_{B_{en}}C_n$ (here $t(en)=n$). Thus $e_n\eta_C$ is the canonical isomorphism $C_n\cong B_{en}\otimes^L_{B_{en}}C_n=F_{en}$, and the specified transition formula at $m=en$ identifies the selected arrows of $UF$ with the actual arrows of $C$ under it. The evaluations jointly detect isomorphisms [lem-pur-system-level-left-extension], so $\eta_C$ is an isomorphism of derived strict systems; write $\phi=\eta_C^{-1}:UF\xrightarrow{\sim}C$, with components $\phi_n:F_{en}\to C_n$.

proof.text: For any $j\geq k$, put $a=t(k)$ and $b=t(j)$. Iterating the specified adjacent maps and their canonical associators gives the map induced by $B_{ea}\otimes^L_{B_{eb}}C_b\to C_a$ after applying $B_k\otimes^L_{B_{ea}}-$. This selected map is an isomorphism by normalization (the identity if $a=b$), and a functor preserves isomorphisms. Hence every transition adjoint of $F$ is invertible. Restriction to $A$ keeps the underlying abelian sheaves and their kernels and cokernels; applied termwise it therefore gives an object of the derived category of strict $A$-towers. Its identities and composition come from the strict system, so this is precisely the coherent normalized tower datum of [def-coef-normalized-dvr-tower].

source.place: Counit paragraph; arithmetic interpolation through the existing strict-system left extension, followed by uniformizer reconstruction (agent elaboration)

proof.text: Apply [lem-sp-strict-tower-arithmetic-restriction] to this underlying strict $A$-tower; it gives $\rho_e:\mathcal L_BF\xrightarrow{\sim}R\varprojlim_n\operatorname{Res}F_{en}$ with $p_n\rho_e=p^F_{en}$. Termwise scalar forgetting commutes with selecting the levels $en$, so the scalar-forgotten $\phi$ of Step 1 is an isomorphism of $A$-towers $r_e\operatorname{Res}F\to\operatorname{Res}C$. Total derived limit is a functor on derived towers whose projections come from its natural Roos triangle [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-strict-tower-homotopy-limit], so $p^C_nR\varprojlim(\phi)=\phi_n p_n$. Put $\rho=R\varprojlim(\phi)\circ\rho_e:\mathcal L_BF\xrightarrow{\sim}M$. Then $p^C_n\rho=\phi_np^F_{en}$ for every $n$, i.e. $\rho$ identifies the projection of $\mathcal L_BF$ at $en$ with that of $M$ to $C_n$ under $\phi_n$. These are total derived limits and their specified projections.

source.place: Counit paragraph; arithmetic interpolation through the existing strict-system left extension, followed by uniformizer reconstruction (agent elaboration)

proof.text: Apply [lem-pur-normalized-actual-reconstruction-maps] to the normalized system $F$, using exactly the uniformizer system and adjunction of [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]. Its actual counit $\mathcal R_B\mathcal L_BF\to F$ is a system isomorphism; its evaluation at $k$ is the scalar-extension adjoint of $p^F_k$. Restrict this system map to $en$, precompose with $U\mathcal R_B(\rho^{-1})$, and postcompose with $\phi:UF\xrightarrow{\sim}C$. On one K-flat representative, $U\mathcal R_B(M)$ is the selected reduction system $(M\otimes_A^LB_{en})_n$. At level $n$ the resulting map is adjoint to $\phi_np^F_{en}\rho^{-1}=p^C_n$, so it is exactly the asserted comparison. All three maps are system isomorphisms, proving both invertibility and coherence of the selected actual counit maps.
